growthFormula: Growth = PO value (Oct 2025–Sep 2026) ÷ PO value (Oct 2024–Sep 2025) − 1, per country × product, on de-duplicated customers (golden IDs). SGD across products; units within a product.
seasonalityNote: We do not compare half-years: dengue season, fiscal-year flushes and CNY/Tet would make that seasonality, not growth.

modelCard.purpose: Give regional management one consistent view of customer demand by country × product, and show how much clean master data changes it.
modelCard.intendedUse: Illustrative prototype on synthetic data; methods are meant to be rerun on SAP B1 extracts in the pilot.
notIntendedFor: Real stock or budget decisions before the pilot validates the method on real data
Forecasting Product C (instruments), which is planned from the tender/PR pipeline

methods.name: Entity resolution
methods.detail: Country + phonetic blocking, name token-set / Jaro-Winkler + tax ID + postcode + phone/email; threshold tuned on SG+MY, reported on TH/VN/MM.

methods.name: Forecast
methods.detail: Damped Holt-Winters ETS vs rolling 6/12-month average and seasonal naive; leak-free 6-origin backtest.

methods.name: Signals
methods.detail: Drop-off (trailing-6M slope + recency vs reorder interval); cross-sell (peer gap within segment; installed-base pull-through as a signal, not a forecast feature).

limitations: All data is synthetic; the planted patterns are known in advance, so good scores here show the pipeline works, not that the patterns exist in Lives Group's data.
Product C is excluded from the forecast headline.
The TS duplicate matcher at intake is a simpler port of the Python matcher.

plantedPatterns.name: Hidden shrinking account (MY)
plantedPatterns.description: 3 records (2 SPD spellings + 1 QTS): one stops after Mar 2026, one starts Apr 2026, one flat; merged it is a top-3 MY account at about −35% YoY.

plantedPatterns.name: Country misattribution from Jan 2026
plantedPatterns.description: SG-coded duplicates capture a MY and a VN hospital's POs from Jan 2026, a level shift in the raw series.
plantedPatterns.assertion: Moves 3–8% of the affected country's 12M value

plantedPatterns.name: False cross-sell gap (TH)
plantedPatterns.description: One hospital looks 'A only' (SPD) plus 'C only' (QTS); merged, the real gap is B.

plantedPatterns.name: Dengue seasonality and swings
plantedPatterns.description: Peaks by country (SG May–Oct, TH Jun–Sep, VN Jul–Nov, MM Jun–Aug, MY mild Nov–Mar); 2024 high → 2025 low; VN 2026 surge.
plantedPatterns.source: NEA, KKM, WHO SEARO, VN press (research log)
plantedPatterns.assertion: ETS beats rolling-12 on A in ≥3 of 5 countries

plantedPatterns.name: Holiday dips
plantedPatterns.description: CNY (SG/MY Feb), Tet (VN Feb), Songkran / Thingyan (TH/MM Apr).

plantedPatterns.name: Fiscal-year flushes on C
plantedPatterns.description: SG/MM Mar, MY/VN Dec, TH Sep.
plantedPatterns.assertion: C peaks in the fiscal year-end month

plantedPatterns.name: Duplicate rate
plantedPatterns.assertion: Held-out P and R each between 0.80 and 0.97

plantedPatterns.name: Miscategorised items (TH)
plantedPatterns.description: Two rapid-test kits coded as lab consumables (B) instead of reagents (A).
plantedPatterns.assertion: ≈3% of TH A value sits in B in the raw view

validatedHere: Pipeline runs end to end and is reproducible from one seed
Backtest is leak-free; losses are reported
Falsification: no advantage when there is no signal

pilotPlan.summary: 6-week pilot in SG + MY on Customer + Item domains for SPD + QTS; rerun this pipeline on B1 extracts in week 1.
pilotPlan.scope: SG + MY · Customer + Item · SPD + QTS
steps: Week 1: extract ORDR/RDR1, OQUT, OCRD, OITM per entity database; run the pipeline unchanged
Week 2: MDM team reviews the top 50 duplicate suggestions; measure real precision
Weeks 3–6: rerun the backtest monthly; compare with today's rolling average
Week 6: keep/kill on the KPIs in the business case

assumptions.text: Five countries: SG, MY, TH, VN, MM.
Entities: SPD (A, diagnostics), QTS (C, instruments), QTG (B, consumables).
History Oct 2023–Sep 2026; window Oct 2025–Sep 2026; forecast Oct–Dec 2026.
Only confirmed POs are volume; PRs are pipeline; enquiries a leading indicator; follow-ups excluded; MDM requests are internal work.
Units within a product; SGD across products.
All data is synthetic with documented planted patterns.
